titleEn: Link Trunks and Explore the Market!

pages.text: "Mom, so many people!" Mina entered the market with their trunk linked to Mom's. High water had made them cross by boat today. The market was full of jars, green fruit, and things to see.
"I'll look where the drums are!" Mina quietly unlinked and ran. The drums boomed; while Mina watched, Mom's footsteps grew distant.
After watching, Mina turned. Mom was gone. Only unfamiliar legs moved around. Mina's trunk tip trembled.
Then Mom's usual words came back: "If you're lost, stop right there." Mina stood with feet together, not taking another step. "It's okay. I can stay here."
Mina called strongly, "Mom!" Then again, "I'm here!" Their voice carried between the people.
Mom's trunk rose above people's heads. She ran over and curled it around Mina's like a firm loop. "Link Trunks and Explore the Market!" Mina held on, too.
Now Mina toured the market with trunks linked. Even booming drums did not make Mina unlink. "I want to see that drum up close."
Mom stopped and brought Mina in front. Still linked, they went to the drum together and listened side by side.
After the tour, Mina looked up. "That drum was really big! Let's see it together next time." Mina held Mom's hand tight.
On the return boat, Mom sat hugging Mina closely. Mina leaned against her. "It was better with you."
